format: rules: [{id, kind (transfer|early_checkin|insurance|room_note), label (Russian button text), when: {condition: value} (all must hold), offer: how the engine finds the offer (tool name or null for a free note / placeholder), placeholder: true when the mock has no such product (never shown as an offer), reason: Russian template with {placeholders} filled by code from computed facts}]. Conditions: arrival_after (HH:MM local arrival at destination is at or after), arrival_before_checkin_min (minutes between arrival and hotel check-in >= value), children (brief has children), variant_has_transfer (variant already has a transfer step), traits_any (brief traits intersect), mood_any (brief mood intersects), prefs (brief prefs equal these values). At most rules.json max_upsell candidates reach a reply.
